caption:
is it an acne scar or just a mark?

Most of what people call acne scars is colour, not texture — and the two behave very differently.

The check needs a window. Stand side-on to the light: a dent throws a small shadow, a flat mark does not. Then run a finger over it. Flat means colour. A dip means shape.

Brown marks are pigment left after a spot, and they are especially common in deeper skin tones. They are rarely quick: in 324 acne patients across seven Asian countries, more than half had brown marks that lasted a year or longer. Picking was commonly reported — and it is the one factor fully in your hands.

A dent is a different question, and one for an in-person assessment rather than a product.

If spots are still arriving, they come first. Marks follow spots.

Abad-Casintahan F et al. J Dermatol 2016 · Tan J et al. J Drugs Dermatol 2017
